title: Contract Administration Standard: Which Renewal Offer Sets the Starting Rate on a Small Business Electricity Supply Renewal
content:
**Offer selection.** For a Small Business Electricity Supply renewal accepted on or before the contract end date, when both expiration notices were issued inside their windows, the initial renewal notice no earlier than 90 and no later than 60 days before the contract end date and the final options notice no later than 30 days before it, and the final options notice states a higher renewal rate than the initial renewal notice, the starting rate is the initial renewal notice's renewal rate; when the final options notice is missing or was issued fewer than 30 days before the contract end date, or the initial renewal notice is missing or was issued outside its window, the starting rate is the agreement's expiring contract rate; in every other case the starting rate is the final options notice's renewal rate.

The 90, 60 and 30 days are the notice points of every Small Business Electricity Supply plan, counted in calendar days back from the contract end date on the agreement record. Where more than one notice of a type is on record, the one with the latest notice date is read.

## Starting rate by notice record

| Initial renewal notice | Final options notice | Rates stated | Starting rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 60 to 90 days before contract end | 30 or more days before contract end | final rate higher than initial rate | initial renewal notice's renewal rate |
| 60 to 90 days before contract end | 30 or more days before contract end | final rate equal to or lower than initial rate | final options notice's renewal rate |
| 60 to 90 days before contract end | missing, or fewer than 30 days before contract end | any | the agreement's expiring contract rate |
| missing, or more than 90 or fewer than 60 days before contract end | any | any | the agreement's expiring contract rate |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical contract end 31 December)

| Notice | Date | Days before contract end | Inside its window |
|---|---|---|---|
| Initial renewal notice | 2 October | 90 | yes |
| Initial renewal notice | 1 October | 91 | no |
| Initial renewal notice | 1 November | 60 | yes |
| Initial renewal notice | 2 November | 59 | no |
| Final options notice | 1 December | 30 | yes |
| Final options notice | 2 December | 29 | no |

## Hypothetical cases

- Initial notice on 15 October at 9.10 cents, final options notice on 25 November at 9.40 cents, expiring rate 8.70 cents: both inside their windows and the final rate is higher, so the starting rate is 9.10 cents.
- Same notices, but the final options notice was issued on 5 December: it is fewer than 30 days before contract end, so the starting rate is the expiring rate of 8.70 cents.
